verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Phoenix supports deterministic code-based evaluators (exact match, regex, custom heuristics) alongside LLM-as-a-judge, and Dataset Evaluators act as test cases scoring outputs automatically in experiments similar to a unit test suite, which is exactly code-based custom scoring for evals. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of writing custom Python scorer code, and no detailed API reference/example showing custom scorer implementation.
